context.transcript:
information and map.
Welcome hikers.
Today your self-guided journey will begin along Chamberlain Trail.
After a short hike on that trail, you'll come to a place where it splits in three.
The trail on the right leads to the ruins of a castle that was built hundreds of years ago.
The left trail takes you along a forest.
Continue straight ahead only if you're an experienced hiker.
There's rugged terrain along that trail.
Now there's a drinking fountain in the visitor's center.
I recommend filling your bottles before you start.
context.transcript_translation:
信息和地图。
欢迎徒步旅行者。
您今天的自助旅程将沿着 Chamberlain Trail 开始。
在沿着这条小径短途徒步后，您会来到一个分叉成三条路的地方。
右边的小径通往一座数百年前建造的城堡遗址。
左边的小径带您穿过一片森林。
只有如果您是经验丰富的徒步旅行者，才继续直行。
沿着那条小径有崎岖的地形。
现在访客中心有一个饮水机。
我建议您在开始前装满您的瓶子。
